hooks.command: { e=$( { "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/bin/principles report-at-session-start 2>&1 1>&3 3>&-; } ); s=$?; } 3>&1; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; case "$s:$e" in 127:*|*'"code":"unsupported_ruby"'*) echo "principles: no supported Ruby was found to run principles. Read $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/setup-ruby/SKILL.md and follow it, asking the user before installing anything.";; *) echo "principles: the session-start report failed with exit status $s. To see why, run: echo '{\"source\":\"startup\"}' | principles report-at-session-start";; esac

j=$(cat); i=${j#*\"tool_use_id\":\"}; [ "$i" != "$j" ] || i=${j#*\"tool_use_id\": \"}; i=${i%%\"*}; case $i in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) exit 0;; esac; d="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/principles-calls"; { [ -d "$d" ] || mkdir -p "$d"; } 2>/dev/null && : 2>/dev/null > "$d/$i"; exit 0

j=$(cat); i=${j#*\"tool_use_id\":\"}; [ "$i" != "$j" ] || i=${j#*\"tool_use_id\": \"}; i=${i%%\"*}; case $i in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) i=;; esac; m="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/principles-calls/$i"; p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; c=; if [ -d "$p/.git" ]; then c="$p/.git"; elif read -r g 2>/dev/null < "$p/.git"; then g=${g#gitdir: }; case $g in /*) ;; *) g="$p/$g";; esac; read -r c 2>/dev/null < "$g/commondir" && case $c in /*) ;; *) c="$g/$c";; esac; else c=$(git -C "$p" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); fi; if [ -n "$i" ] && [ -f "$m" ] && [ -f "$c/logs/HEAD" ]; then set --; for r in "$c/logs/HEAD" "$c"/worktrees/*/logs/HEAD; do [ -f "$r" ] && set -- "$@" -newer "$r"; done; o=$(find "$m" "$@" 2>/dev/null); rm -f "$m"; [ -z "$o" ] || exit 0; fi; printf '%s\n' "$j" | "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/bin/principles report-after-commit 2>/dev/null || true
